newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil weakens with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil weakens with crude.

text.p: NWE high and low sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices were notionally steady to weaker with crude oil futures on Wednesday, traders said.
Russian high sulphur cargoes were still on offer and one dealer was heard still holding E-4 product on a very prompt vessel. It was offered at $97 cif NWE and bid $3 below that.
A refiner was heard to have bought an M-100 from Tallinn on Tuesday at a healthy $2.50 over the mean/mean of quotes.
Traders and industry consultants estimated Russian fuel oil exports in February from the Baltics and the Black Sea at around 600,000 tonnes and 400,000 tonnes respectively.
The total for Europe is only around five percent up from January but was estimated to have been three times the rate in February 1996.
